title: Project Serpo book built on Puthoff's spacetime metric engineering
summary: Deep Prasad tells of Project Serpo book built on Puthoff's spacetime metric engineering, about 2005 onward (read c. 2019-2020) at United States (no place named), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and one thing that stood out to me was that the whole project Serpo book completely integrates Halputo off spaceimetric engineering.

plain: A researcher, Deep Prasad, says that when he read the Project Serpo book around 2019 or 2020, one thing stood out. The book, based on papers leaked from 2005 onward that claim the US swapped people with an alien planet, fully weaves in the ideas of a physicist named Hal Puthoff about "spacetime metric engineering," the notion of reshaping space and time itself to travel. To Prasad, that overlap would mean the story is tied to serious physics thinking rather than standing alone.
